name: Add-on Manager (reference mock)
notes: Visual/UX target for AddonManager_UI runtime-built panel. Hex sRGB; Unity colors are linearized in code.

unity_parity_vs_react_ref.interactive_list: Addon_MGR registry, enable/disable, uninstall, OnAddonEnabledStateChanged → RefreshAddonsList
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.filter_search: Toggle group All/Enabled/Disabled; TMP search on id + listSubtitle
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.action_buttons: Install zip, refresh discovery, load enabled now, restart-with-addons bat — RefGreen/RefBlue/RefBtnDefault
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.shortcut_overlay: Blocker child ShortcutBackdropHints — low-contrast VIEWPORT hints (RMB+WASD, orbit, pan, zoom, focus, menu)
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.motion: Dimmer + panel CanvasGroup alpha and slight scale via coroutine (unscaled time); row + footer link pointer hover
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.responsive: CanvasScaler + AddonManager_ResponsiveLayout; shared tokens in ProjectUiScale (8px Space, Tailwind-aligned breakpoints, ClampModalSize). Reuse for other overlays.
unity_parity_vs_react_ref.icons: TMP glyphs / text labels — not Lucide SVGs
